## Documentation Request

### What documentation is missing or unclear?

A clear description of what documentation you'd like to see.

### Which section does this relate to?

- [ ] API Documentation
- [ ] Component Documentation
- [ ] Functions Reference
- [ ] Quick Start Guide
- [ ] Examples
- [ ] Contributing Guide
- [ ] Other (please specify)

### What would you like to see documented?

Describe the specific topic, feature, or use case you want documented.

### Why is this documentation important?

Explain why this documentation would be valuable.

### Proposed Content (optional)

If you have ideas about what the documentation should include, share them here.

### Related Links (optional)

- Link to related code
- Link to related issues
- Link to existing partial documentation

### Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or examples.
